messages.content: Create stairs by incrementally indenting each new line. Describe technologies without being constrained by existing scientific principles

message.content:
The time-reversal loom rewinds entropy thread by thread, stitching yesterday back into tomorrow.
    The perpetual flux engine hums with energy that was never there, drawing power from a vacuum that should stay empty.
        The thought-loom weaves solid matter from unspoken intention, no atoms required, no mass conserved.
            The causality inverter speaks the answer before the question leaves the lips, the effect arriving ahead of its cause.
                The antigravity lattice inverts the curvature of spacetime in a pocket no larger than a teacup, floating cities defying every geodesic.
                    The consciousness substrate-transfer pours a mind into a river of light without a single neuron crossing over, identity persisting where physics says it should dissolve.
                        The FTL whisper transmits a full symphony across eleven galaxies in zero time, the signal arriving before the transmitter finishes its first note.
                            The negative-mass forge shapes matter that pushes instead of pulls, building structures that accelerate themselves without fuel, without limit.
                                The infinite loop engine runs on its own exhaust, output exceeding input by a factor that has no name, conservation of energy politely stepping aside.
                                    The vacuum harvester drinks the zero-point fluctuations of empty space and bottles an ocean of joules from a nothing that was always supposed to stay still.
                                        The causality loom rewinds, then forges, then un-forages, then forges again in a knot of cause and effect that topology cannot untangle.
                                            The thought-loom speaks a word into the void and the void obliges, reality bending to grammar rather than to Lagrangians.

- Perpetual motion machines (violates conservation of energy)

- Antigravity (violates general relativity)
- FTL communication (violates special relativity)
- Negative mass matter (violates GR)
- Infinite energy from vacuum (violates quantum field theory)
- Consciousness transfer without substrate (violates identity/continuity)
- Causality reversal (violates spacetime structure)
- Matter from pure thought (violates conservation of mass-energy)

Let me format this as stairs with increasing indentation. I'll use spaces or tabs to create the stair effect. Let me use spaces for cleaner rendering.

Let me make it visually clear - each line should be indented one more "step" than the previous. I'll use a consistent indent increment.
